summary: "Balance of Power: Late Edition" focuses on the intersection of politics and global business. On today's show, Republican Congressman Darrell Issa of California reacts to President Trump's threats against Oman, saying the President's comments should be taken "in context." Longtime Democratic strategist Jim Messina discusses Florida's primaries and whether democratic socialist candidates can broaden their appeal ahead of the midterms. Michael O'Hanlon, Director of Research in the Foreign Policy program at the Brookings Institution, assesses the Iran campaign so far, calling some of President Trump's decisions "impulsive." Former US Attorney General Alberto Gonzales says Attorney General Todd Blanche is "partly right" in arguing that the Justice Department should not operate independently of the White House. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Former AG: Blanche is 'Partly Right' on DOJ Independence
title_cn: 前总检察长：布兰奇关于司法部独立的观点“部分正确”
summary: Former US Attorney General Alberto Gonzales says Attorney General Todd Blanche is "partly right" in arguing that the Justice Department should not operate independently of the White House, saying an attorney general should carry out a president's law-enforcement priorities but remain independent when it comes to investigations and prosecutions. Gonzales calls it "absolutely wrong" for a president to publicly direct an attorney general to investigate or prosecute someone without a legal basis. He also weighs in on the Justice Department's expanded election monitoring and efforts to obtain state voter rolls, saying "there is no evidence" of alleged massive voter fraud. He speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on the late edition of Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: O'Hanlon: Trump's Iran Decisions Have Been 'Impulsive'
title_cn: 奥汉隆：特朗普的伊朗决定是“冲动的”
summary: Michael O'Hanlon, Director of Research in the Foreign Policy program at the Brookings Institution, assesses the Iran campaign so far, calling some of President Trump's decisions "impulsive" while crediting him with showing restraint in avoiding attacks that could inflict mass civilian casualties. O'Hanlon says neither the US nor Iran has attractive options for escalation and expects the conflict to remain at a "low level of simmer" as both sides test the other's tolerance for economic pain. He says the US has the military means to overthrow Iran's regime if severely provoked, but doing so would require a ground invasion on the scale of Iraq and Afghanistan combined. He speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on the late edition of Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

He also weighs in on the DNC's revamped 2028 presidential primary calendar, saying the new lineup could favor a candidate who can unite the party around cost-of-living issues. He speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on the late edition of Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Trump Shouldn't Rush Iran Strategy: Rep. Issa
title_cn: 特朗普不应催促伊朗战略：众议员伊萨
summary: Republican Congressman Darrell Issa of California reacts to President Trump's threats against Oman, saying the President's comments should be taken "in context." Issa describes the confrontation with Iran as a 47-year problem and says Trump shouldn't feel pressured to resolve it on a political timeline, arguing that appearing to be in a hurry would play into Iran's hands. He also discusses conditions aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln as the USS George Washington makes its way to the region to relieve the carrier. He speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on the late edition of Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Trump’s Big Bend Border Project Paused After Bulldozers Arrive
title_cn: 推土机抵达后特朗普的大弯边境项目暂停
summary: The Trump administration is pausing work on a border security project inside Texas’ Big Bend National Park, days after bulldozers began clearing land in one of the least-crossed stretches of the US-Mexico border.

title: DOJ Official Flags Stanford for Scrutiny Over Foreign Donations
title_cn: 司法部官员要求斯坦福大学对外国捐赠进行审查
summary: Stanford University is facing increased scrutiny from the Justice Department over donations from foreign sources and its practices around international students and admissions, according to a senior agency official.

title: Trump’s Civil Rights Chief Dhillon on Election Security, DEI
title_cn: 特朗普民权事务负责人迪隆谈选举安全、DEI
summary: The announcement of election monitors comes amid growing apprehension among Democrats about federal interference at the polls.

title: AI Buildout: Benefits & Challenges as Chip Stocks Rally
title_cn: 人工智能建设：芯片股上涨带来的好处与挑战
summary: Nora Wittstruck, Chief Analytical Officer for Governments at S&P Global Ratings, discussed the current and future impact of AI adoption on government credit quality. She emphasized that while AI represents a broad range of technologies, its influence on credit quality will not be immediate. She speaks with Scarlet Fu & Isabelle Lee on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: DOJ Plans to Deploy 1,000 Monitors to Watch Midterm Elections
title_cn: DOJ 计划部署 1,000 名监视器来观看中期选举
summary: The Justice Department plans to send 1,000 monitors to watch voting during the midterm elections in November, a historic figure for a Republican administration, Assistant Attorney General Harmeet Dhillon said.

title: Trump Says North Korea's Kim Jong Un Treats Him With Great Respect
title_cn: 特朗普称朝鲜金正恩非常尊重他
summary: President Donald Trump said North Korean strongman Kim Jong Un had responded to requests for the two leaders to have a conversation, as Trump moved to cut back military drills with South Korea, a traditional US ally. Trump says Kim has always treated him with "great respect." (Source: Bloomberg)
